problem_statement: Tailwind Admin Template is a static Tailwind 2 admin dashboard with a blue sidebar shell, Karla-style typography, a KPI/chart zone (Monthly Reports and Resolved Reports cards), a Latest Reports client table, an Alpine-driven avatar menu, a mobile hamburger nav, and component routes (Tables, Forms, Tabbed Content, Calendar, Blank Page). Extend the main dashboard page with an Operations focus mode attention layer that feels native to the local visual system. The new page-level control must let an operator switch between Revenue pulse, Support queue, and Risk watch views without leaving index.html, while preserving the original sidebar, KPI/chart cards, client table, Alpine avatar menu, component routes, and responsive dashboard rhythm.
required_content: Add a visible Operations focus mode area to the main dashboard page between the KPI/chart cards and the Latest Reports table.
Provide three clickable focus controls labeled Revenue pulse, Support queue, and Risk watch.
The default visible panel must be Revenue pulse: Stripe payout review, showing payout/sales context (Account balance, New sales, Payouts due) with a live readout.
Clicking Support queue must reveal Support queue: 18 pending handoffs with support-triage context and update the live readout to that focus.
Clicking Risk watch must reveal Risk watch: 3 SLA breaches tied to denied or expired client-table rows, and update the live readout.
The focus mode must follow the template's existing typography, spacing, rounded card surfaces, shadow treatment, blue accent, gray text hierarchy, and responsive layout.
Surface the same Operations focus mode area on the Tables and Forms routes so the attention layer is a consistent cross-page dashboard element, not an index-only widget.

Keep the original Dashboard heading, New Report CTA, Monthly Reports and Resolved Reports charts, Latest Reports table, sidebar routes (Tables, Forms, Tabbed Content, Calendar, Blank Page), avatar menu, and mobile sidebar control available.
Ground the task in existing visual states: KPI/chart summary, in-page focus panel, client-table statuses, secondary routes, and the mobile sidebar interaction.
Implement the interaction in source HTML/JS/CSS only; do not add dependencies, remote media, generated screenshots, iframe shortcuts, or unrelated routes.
design_constraints: Treat the task as a page-level interaction extension inside index.html (mirrored on the Tables and Forms routes), not as a redesign, separate landing page, modal-only feature, or detached marketing block.
Place the new interaction between the existing KPI/chart card grid and the existing client table so it reads as a dashboard attention layer.
Reuse the local utility vocabulary already present: white card surfaces, rounded corners, subtle shadow, the blue primary accent, gray text hierarchy, and border dividers.
The selected tab state must be visually distinct and reflected in aria-selected or an equivalent accessible state.
Support desktop, tablet, and 390px mobile captures without horizontal overflow, clipped labels, or overlapping controls.
The existing table and component routes must remain reachable, and the mobile hamburger must continue to open the original sidebar menu.

change_completion: Operations focus mode area exists between the KPI/chart cards and the Latest Reports table on index.html.
All three focus tabs (Revenue pulse, Support queue, Risk watch) are present and clickable, with Revenue pulse the default.
design_consistency: Focus panel reuses the template's card surface, rounded corners, shadow, blue accent, and gray text hierarchy.
The Operations focus area appears consistently on the index, Tables, and Forms routes.
responsive: No horizontal overflow at 390px mobile or tablet widths across the focus tab row and summary-tile row.
Tabs and tiles wrap rather than forcing a fixed-width row that overflows the mobile viewport.
regression: Original Dashboard heading, charts, client table, sidebar routes, and mobile hamburger remain intact and reachable.
Clicking a focus tab updates both the visible panel and the live readout to the selected focus.

state_constraints: desktop_initial checks the original dashboard shell (sidebar, KPI/chart cards, Latest Reports table) renders intact.
mobile_initial checks the dashboard renders at 390px with no horizontal overflow.
desktop_focus_revenue checks the default Operations focus panel (Revenue pulse) with its tabs, tiles, context card and live readout is legible and laid out cleanly.
desktop_focus_support checks that clicking Support queue updates the panel AND the live readout to that focus.
desktop_focus_risk checks that clicking Risk watch updates the panel AND the live readout to that focus.
tablet_focus_revenue and mobile_focus_revenue check the focus tab row and summary-tile row wrap without horizontal overflow.
desktop_tables_route and desktop_forms_route check the Operations focus section is present cross-page (not index-only).
desktop_table_regression checks the original Latest Reports client table remains reachable below the focus section.
mobile_sidebar_toggle checks the mobile hamburger still opens the original sidebar nav.

levers.D6_no_horizontal_overflow: Operations-focus tab row + summary-tile row wrap on mobile (ref 0 / baseline +479 / bad +599).
levers.D2_dom_assertions: Operations-focus section present cross-page (index+tables+forms in reference; index-only in baseline+bad).
levers.D3_visual_regression: Default desktop Revenue focus region collapses into an overlapping near-white-on-near-white pile on bad.
levers.D4_interaction_assertions: Clicking Support queue updates the live readout on reference/baseline; bad leaves the readout frozen at the init snapshot.

author_notes: Reassigned from technext/windmill-dashboard (a duplicate of slot_204) to the long-tail davidgrzyb/tailwind-admin-template repo, same dashboard_admin genre and same operations_focus_mode intent. The native lever is the dashboard's own Operations focus attention layer (tab row + summary tiles + context card + live readout) placed in the widget zone between the chart cards and the client table. Reference wraps fluidly and wires the readout live. The bad solution collapses the focus region into an overlapping, illegible near-white-on-near-white pile and freezes the readout at its init snapshot. Assets vendored offline (Tailwind, Alpine, Chart.js, FontAwesome webfont, placeholder SVG images); no remote requests. Screenshots and image crops of the focus region are the multimodal evidence for the visual-regression and responsive gates.
